product_metadata.title: A.J.A. & MORE Lint Bin for Laundry Room Organization | Garbage Can with Magnetic Strip | Wall Mounted Bathroom Trash Can | Hang This Wastebasket on Wall, on Washer/Dryer or Laundry Room Door (Grey)
features: ✔ ONE & ONLY: This A.J.A. & MORE lint bin is a genius waste and space-saving solution, and the very first laundry room organizer of its kind! This container has a sleek design specially designed to collect and store dryer lint from your clothes, other laundry room debris, such as dryer sheets, and more. You will not find any other product like it!

✔ SPACE SAVER: Super effective for home organization! Unlike other organizer bins, this durable plastic lint bin has a super strong magnet backing that can be directly attached to the side of your metal washing machine or dryer. Or, you can use its built-in keyhole hanger to easily mount it to the wall. Hardware not included.

✔ SLEEK DESIGN: Replace that plain box you've been using for the lost lint from your lint trap. Take your laundry room décor up a notch with the bin’s sleek, modern design. Its neutral beige color goes seamlessly with any color scheme, so you'll be sure to have cute room decor. “Lint Bin” is elegantly printed in script font. The sign says it all! Other containers can't measure up!

✔ REPURPOSE YOUR LINT: Did you know that there are many things you can reuse dryer lint for? Even a small ball of lint can be useful! You can make clay out of it for the kids, make paper mache, line planters with it, add it to handmade paper, make a fire starter kit, or use the natural fibers for mulch or compost.

✔ CLEAR THE WAY: This lint bin for laundry room organization and storage replaces the need to keep a trash can on your laundry room floor or laundry room shelves by your dryer vent cleaner and detergent. Use this space-saving, environmentally friendly waste solution instead. Overall size is 9.25" wide x 9.25" high x 2.75" deep. Bin is 3mm thick, and magnetic backing is 6.25" wide x 5.5" long.
